variants.headline: Assembly votes down government bill
variants.body: A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A proposal meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Government legislation fails the vote
variants.body: A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
